construct.name: Ptef1 (A. nidulans tef1 / AN4218)
construct.notes: No tail on the reverse primer, so all homology at the promoter|CDS seam is carried by each CDS forward primer. One promoter primer pair serves the whole library.

Four real coding sequences, inline as FASTA. They are the library's own fluorescent proteins and marker rather than biosynthetic genes -- FLOW carries no cds parts, so this slot is always the user's own, and these stand in as real DNA of the right size and composition.
